scenes.heading: Pricing virtual assistant work: hourly, retainer, or package

sents.d: Pricing virtual assistant work: hourly, retainer, or package
Retainers are common in this field because the work itself is ongoing.
Hourly pricing is simple and transparent but can create anxiety on both sides — clients worry about hours adding up, and VAs are penalized for working efficiently.

Retainer pricing (a set number of hours per month for a flat fee) is the norm in this field, giving clients predictable costs and VAs predictable income, though it requires tracking hours carefully to avoid consistently overdelivering for free.
Package pricing (a flat fee for a defined deliverable, like 'inbox zero setup and one month of management') works well for bounded projects rather than ongoing open-ended support.

take: Use retainers for ongoing work and packages for projects.
